prior_findings.claim: A stale toplevel is not necessarily the picker's origin: open() trusts Hyprland.activeToplevel, which Quickshell does not clear on an empty activewindowv2, so opening the picker on an empty workspace can refocus and paste into a window on the previous workspace.
prior_findings.reason: originAddress() accepts the active toplevel only when its workspace id equals Hyprland.focusedWorkspace.id and the remembered fallback is removed; the empty-workspace (and empty-monitor, closed-special) sequences now yield explicit --copy-only. Both reviewers agree the original cross-workspace condition is closed (Sol initially rated F1 'still_present, narrower' for a same-workspace variant; after cross-examination the only realistic default-config sequence, lock/unlock with pointer off-window, gives the same paste target as base because Hyprland keeps A as its focused window and refocuses it on overlay unmap; Sol's follow-up concedes the stronger no-active-window subcase is not demonstrated).

New regression, found independently by both reviewers: Quickshell focusedWorkspace never names a special workspace (no activespecial handler) and Hyprland's special toggle emits no workspacev2, so a focused scratchpad window is always rejected and selections become copy-only where base and 87f3010 pasted. Omarchy ships the scratchpad by default.

Low-impact, fail-safe: Quickshell sets activeToplevel only from non-empty activewindowv2 events, never at startup; after omarchy-restart-shell selections are copy-only until focus changes. Opus found it; Sol independently confirmed on a neutral follow-up question.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up at `90ad54b` to the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12991#issuecomment-5789710612) and the [author's update](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12991#issuecomment-5804249542). The earlier stale-window finding is resolved. Two new fail-safe regressions: a selection made while the scratchpad console is focused is now copied but no longer pasted, and selections are copy-only after a shell restart until focus changes.

**Verified (source inspection plus an isolated run with stubbed desktop tools):**

| Earlier finding / author claim | Result at `90ad54b` |
|---|---|
| Stale toplevel from another workspace captured as origin | **Resolved.** [`originAddress()`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/90ad54b275fd503c71ff10b8468b4c46d424b4da/shell/plugins/clipboard/ClipboardHistory.js#L86-L89) returns an origin only when the toplevel's workspace matches `Hyprland.focusedWorkspace`. After switching to an empty workspace, selections are passed with `--copy-only`: no refocus, no workspace switch. |
| No remembered fallback | Confirmed: `lastToplevelAddress` is removed. |
| Helpers fail closed | Confirmed: after the retries, both helpers send Shift+Insert only if `hyprctl activewindow -j` equals the normalized target. Otherwise the data stays copied and `wtype` is not called. |
| Address format | Quickshell's lowercase unprefixed hex plus the helpers' `0x` prefix matches Hyprland's `activewindow -j` address. |
| Regression tests | `test/shell.d/clipboard-test.sh` passes at the head. The head's test fails on the base at its first new assertion. |

## Scratchpad selections become copy-only

Quickshell's `focusedWorkspace` is the focused monitor's regular workspace. It has no handler for `activespecial`/`activespecialv2`. Toggling a special workspace in Hyprland focuses its window but emits no `workspacev2`. A window on `special:scratchpad` (negative workspace ID) therefore never matches, and `originAddress()` returns `""`.

Source-traced sequence, not a live desktop reproduction:

```text
SUPER+S -> scratchpad window S focused (workspace special:scratchpad)
        -> SUPER+CTRL+V; focusedWorkspace is still the regular workspace
        -> originAddress(S, focusedWorkspace) == ""
        -> Enter/click an entry
Base:     copy, then Shift+Insert reaches S after the overlay closes
87f3010:  capture S, refocus S, paste into S
90ad54b:  --copy-only; no paste
```

Omarchy enables this scratchpad by default ([`qconsole.lua`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/90ad54b275fd503c71ff10b8468b4c46d424b4da/default/hypr/qconsole.lua), bound to SUPER+S and SUPER+grave in [`tiling.lua`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/90ad54b275fd503c71ff10b8468b4c46d424b4da/default/hypr/bindings/tiling.lua#L28-L31)).

**Impact:** Picking an entry from the scratchpad console copies it without pasting, where the base and the previous revision pasted. The failure is safe: nothing goes to the wrong window.

**Suggested change:** Also accept a toplevel on the special workspace currently shown on the focused monitor, and keep rejecting it once that special workspace closes. Optional approaches: track `activespecialv2` through `Hyprland.rawEvent`, seeded from the monitor's `specialWorkspace`, or check Hyprland's current active window when the picker opens. A unit case for a special-workspace toplevel would cover it. These approaches have not been tested here.

## Selections are copy-only after a shell restart until focus changes

Quickshell sets `Hyprland.activeToplevel` only from a non-empty `activewindowv2` event, not at startup. After `omarchy-restart-shell` (also run by font changes and updates), `originAddress()` receives a null toplevel, so selections are copy-only until focus changes once. The base and `87f3010` attempted a paste in that interval.

**Impact:** Transient and fail-safe: in the interval between a shell restart and the next focus change, selections copy without pasting.

**Suggested change:** Checking Hyprland's current active window when the picker opens, as in the approach above, would also cover this interval. Not tested here.
